company_info.description: Sanko Sangyo Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of adhesive and adhesive-backed printed materials in Japan. Its products are used in industrial products, including seals, labels, and stickers, as well as electronic devices; and display boards for office equipment, control panels, display windows for digital cameras and mobile phones, and automotive equipment. The company also provides a range of printed materials comprising general commercial printed materials, cards, POP displays, promotional items, and original goods. Sanko Sangyo Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1951 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
